## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Mutating team operations require org ownership (reqOrgOwnership middleware) | authorization | User is not site admin AND not org owner |
| Cannot remove last member of owner team | validation | team.IsOwnerTeam() AND team.NumMembers == 1 |
| Removing team member removes user from org if they have no other team memberships | business_logic | User has no remaining team_user records for the org |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| removing last owner team member | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **team not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **user not found** → GetContextUserByPathParam → 404
- **last owner of org** → removeTeamMember → 500
